title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Restaurant Ordering and Delivery Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a restaurant or food business ordering app: a menu the owner can edit, cart and checkout, order push notifications, delivery logic, and no per-order commission.
body_markdown:
Blink, at 71 out of 80, because it builds an editable menu, cart, Stripe checkout, order push, and accounts on one database. Adalo is second at 61 and leads on delivery maps.


Not to the builder. Blink prices by credits, with no per-order fee. Payment processing fees from Stripe still apply.


Apple's guideline 3.1.3(e) says physical goods and services consumed outside the app use methods such as Apple Pay or card entry rather than in-app purchase, and Blink connects Stripe for checkout.


Yes. Blink designs the menu tables from your prompt, and you edit items and prices in a visual row editor or by asking the agent.


Adalo lists a Google Maps integration and geolocation, which gives it the top delivery score here. Blink is second at 7 and wins the other seven criteria.
